    2. Volume and volatility

    Volume and volatility

    The trading volume behind a price move, how volatile the move is, and how both shape the way a move is read.

    • What is volume?

      • Volume and volatility

      Volume is the amount traded during the period a candle covers.

    • Price and volume

      • Volume and volatility

      Reading price and volume together shows how much participation came with a move.

    • Breakouts and volume

      • Volume and volatility

      When judging a breakout, the breakout candle's volume is compared with the average volume of recent candles.

    • Volume profile (POC, VAH, VAL)

      • Volume and volatility

      A volume profile spreads the volume traded over a chosen period by price instead of by time.

    • What is volatility? Contracting and expanding ranges

      • Volume and volatility

      Volatility is the size of price changes; it describes how much price moves, not which way.

    • Price gaps

      • Volume and volatility

      A price gap is when a candle opens above or below the previous candle's range without overlapping it, leaving an area of price where no trading took place.

    • FVG: fair value gap

      • Volume and volatility

      An FVG is the gap left between the wicks of the candles on either side of a strong candle.

    • Price behaviour after sharp moves

      • Volume and volatility

      After a large move in a short time, price can follow one of three broad paths: it can continue in the same direction, move sideways, or give back part of the move.
